cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.

mechanism: A takes charge of returning a sentimental gnome by giving repairable truths in stages, then changes the repair plan to respect B attachment.
confusable: Simple minimisation lacks truthful layers that change the meaning of coming home and show whose feelings A is protecting.
comparison: Wedding alternative centres event logistics; this one protects an owner attachment to a particular object.
seedUse: Gnome seed supplies packed pieces and smile; replace the explanation of saying home first with a practical recovery offer that B can redirect.
